run.command: strata bench run --profile <data-dir>\bench-2026-11-10-iq3_xxs-v0.2.13.1.json --track custom --track-notes Strata 0.2.13.1 (tag v0.2.13.1, commit 628f7495), engine 0.1.59 built from source (cmake+ninja, MSVC 19.44, CUDA 13.4, sm_120, BUILD.json source=local). Run config = setup defaults plus the calibration written on 2026-10-31: --pool-workers 5 --adapt-every 1 --adapt-swaps 160 --adapt-decay 0.97 --vram-reserve-mib 700, --expert-profile data/expert-profile.bin, --expert-cache auto --prefill auto --kv int8 --max-context 262144. No --pcie-frac: the engine refines the PCIe share itself on a single CUDA card (PcieAuto); an explicit --pcie-frac 1.00 measured 80.5 tok/s chat decode against 92.0 without it on this machine, so the flag was removed before this run. Drafter: DFlash2 from the run config default drafting=auto (--draft dflash2 --spec 6 --draft-conf 0.7, no MTP layer); the --spec 4, --spec-min-p 0.70 and --mtp entries in the config are replaced by that decision. --vision is on; none of the measured requests used an image. --model-revision ed59f92082b1e93c0e96d60a8b11aab089b52f09 --quantization IQ3_XXS --tokenizer-revision ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-GGUF @ ed59f92082b1e93c0e96d60a8b11aab089b52f09 --custom-pack Strata IQ-Pack (packs/iq3_xxs, tools/iq_pack.py, conversions.json) with native_experts.txt v3 and index.txt; the second GGUF shard is passed as --ple-gguf; data/expert-profile.bin (expert profile shipped with the release); MTP draft vocabulary mtp/rt/draft_vocab.bin --background Windows 11 desktop: explorer, StartMenuExperienceHost, SearchHost, Edge WebView2, Firefox, Signal, Cryptomator, ArgusMonitor, ScanSnap, UniGetUI, Acronis TrueImage; about 1.4 GiB VRAM in use before the run (nvidia-smi) --build-options CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=120,CUDA 13.4,MSVC 19.44,cmake+ninja,source build,vision:gpu

background_workloads: Windows 11 desktop: explorer, StartMenuExperienceHost, SearchHost, Edge WebView2, Firefox, Signal, Cryptomator, ArgusMonitor, ScanSnap, UniGetUI, Acronis TrueImage; about 1.4 GiB VRAM in use before the run (nvidia-smi)
